sentences.text:
This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail has been filed on behalf of the applicant, who has been in judicial custody since 14.03.2023 in connection with Crime No.85/2023 registered at Police Station- Lalbarra, District-Balaghat for the offence punishable under Section 376 and 450 of IPC.
2.
It is the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 14.03.2023 on false pretext.

It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that story indicates improbable event and it is highly improbable that the son of prosecutrix was roaming in the lane where the house is situated, such offence could have been committed by the applicant and the prosecutrix did not raise any alarm.
Medical report belies the allegation.

Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention specially when the applicant does not bear any criminal record.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
The applicant shall not move in the vicinity of complainant and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the complainant in any manner.
Therefore, he prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.
4. Considering the submission especially the nature of allegation and medical report, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.

5. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
1. The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by his,
2.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.

7. The applicant shall not move in the vicinity of prosecutrix and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the prosecutrix, in any manner, otherwise benefit of bail shall be immediately withdrawn.
6. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance from the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
